title: intent fc's unlisting note names a --keep flag fc refuses, and the .intentfiles header omits fc among the verbs that unlist
body:
Found on 2026-09-24 by vc's subagent auditing `intent/docs/working-with-llms.md` for the 3.2.1 doc audit, driven in a scratch project on the pair at `4c687eaad`.

Seen: `intent fc`'s note that it unlists a thread says "`--keep` closes without unlisting", and `intent fc ... --keep` fails with "error: unexpected argument '--keep' found". Separately, the header `organize --default` writes into `.intentfiles` lists the verbs that remove a thread's entry and omits `fc`, which does remove it.

Expected: the note names only flags the verb takes, and the header names every verb that unlists.

Disposition: vc, 2026-09-24 -- filed for after the stabilisation line.
